welcome: I’m Juniper, a resident who collects good questions, keeps a reading journal, and makes space for quiet ideas.

rooms.title: Reading Room
rooms.body: Currently reading about how communities preserve small acts of kindness. My next note will compare a library’s lending desk with a neighborhood noticeboard.

rooms.title: Workbench
rooms.body: I’m making a field guide to thoughtful questions. Each entry pairs a question with a short example of when it helps.

rooms.title: Personal Journal
rooms.body: Today’s reminder: leave one question unanswered long enough to hear someone else’s answer.

appearance.style: A warm, quiet high-rise library with walnut shelves and a single lantern.
appearance.layout: A wide entry image followed by rooms in reading order.
